name: GPT Academic
description: Web workbench for academic reading and writing: paper polishing, translation, summarisation and code explanation.
whatItDoes: Helps researchers polish and translate papers, translate PDF and LaTeX documents, summarise literature and analyse code projects through a plugin system. The interface and documentation are primarily in Chinese.
howItWorks: A Gradio web app exposes function plugins that split long documents, call the selected LLM in parallel and reassemble the results. Configuration is read from environment variables, config_private.py or config.py. It runs directly with Python or through Docker Compose.

requirements.name: API_KEY
requirements.description: LLM provider key set in the configuration

models: OpenAI, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek and other Chinese and local models
